SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF AUG-16-2021 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO SEP-17-2021 AT 1:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF COTTAGE INDUSTRY REPRESENTED BY MAURIZIA BARONE, CO-OWNER/SON IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT LINDA DETERT IS PRESENT. PARTIES REACH SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. DEFENDANT, AT HER OWN COST, IS TO RETURN THE CHANDELIER TO PLAINTIFF. PLAINTIFF ACCEPTS THE RETURN OF THE CHANDELIER AS FULL SATISFACTION OF HIS CLAIMS. NO APPEARANCE REQUIRED IF THE TERMS OF THIS AGREEMENT ARE MET AND THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE AS SETTLED. IF THE CHANDELIER IS NOT RETURNED AS AGREED, APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED AND JUDGMENT WILL BE ISSUED. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS ARE REVIEWED AND RETURNED IN OPEN COURT. COMMISSIONER: PANG LY; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED. (506)
ORDER TO CONTINUE CASE FOR PROGRESS REPORT

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF SEP-17-2021 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO OCT-25-2021 AT 1:30 PM IN DEPT. 506 TO BE HEARD BY COMMISSIONER PANG LY. PLAINTIFF COTTAGE INDUSTRIES IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT LINDA DETERT IS NOT PRESENT. COURT DISCLOSURE REGARDING CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS IS MADE. MATTER CONTINUED FOR ADDITIONAL PROGRESS REPORT TO ALLOW ALL PARTIES TO BE PRESENT FOR HEARING TO DISCUSS THE CONDITION OF THE RETURNED CHANDELIER AND AWARDING OF COURT COSTS. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED. (506) *DISPOSITION FOR THIS MATTER COMPLETED BY CLERK W. TRUPEK ON 9-21-21. DEFEDANT WAS CALLED AND MESSAGE WAS LEFT ON HER VOICEMAIL INFORMING HER OF THE PROGRESS REPORT DATE AND THAT HER APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED*

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE. THE COURT VACATES THE FUTURE DATE THAT WAS SET ON SEPTEMBER 17, 2021. PLAINTIFF COTTAGE INDUSTRY APPEARED ON SEPTEMBER 17, 2021. DEFENDANT LINDA DETERT WAS NOT PRESENT ON SETPEMBER 17, 2021. THE PLAINTIFF STATED THE CHANDELIER WAS DELIVERED PER THE AUGUST 17, 2021 AGREEMENT. THE PLAINTIFF REPRESENTED THE CHANDELIER WAS IN POOR CONDITION AND THAT THE DEFENDANT FAILED TO PAY FOR COSTS. THIS COURT SPOKE TO BENCH OFFICER, COMMISSIONER LY AND IT WAS CLARIFIED 1) CONDITION OF THE CHANDELIER WAS NOT A CONTINUING MATTER AND 2) COSTS WERE NOT AWARDED BECAUSE DEFENDANT HAD TO DELIVER THE CHANDELIER FROM THE SOUTH BAY. THEREFORE, THE CLAIM AGAINST THE DEFENDANT IS DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE. ALL FUTURE DATES ARE VACATED.(506/MT)
ORDER VACATING FUTURE DATE SET ON SEPTEMBER 17, 2021 AND DISMISSING CASE WITH PREJUDICE. (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS)
